'''Mykka''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]], who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Mykka worked as a waiter in the bar [[Spanner's]], which was located in the city of [[Hedrett]], on Cularin. He had worked there for a couple of years when the [[heroes of Cularin]] visited the bar in about [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]].

==Personality and traits==
Mykka had an athletic build. He liked the clientale and atmosphere of Spanner's, and was good at his job.
